from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialAssetEntry(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial asset value found in a document's statements."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company name associated with this report")
    reporting_year: int = Field(description="The fiscal year end of the report (e.g. 2023)")
    line_item_name: str = Field(description="The specific name of the financial line item (e.g. 'Right of use assets, net')")
    value: float = Field(description="The numeric value of the asset as reported")
    currency: str = Field(description="The currency of the value")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short text snippet verifying the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_asset_entries: list[FinancialAssetEntry]
